Juliana, we like the gold package very much. But the price is a problem for us. Can you give us a discount?
I understand. What discount do you have in mind?
Twenty percent. Our budget is smaller this year.
Twenty percent is difficult. But if you sign for two years, we will give you ten percent.
Ten is not enough. How about fifteen, and we sign for two years?
Let us meet halfway. Fifteen percent, if you pay the first year upfront.
Upfront... OK. If our director agrees, we will send the contract on Friday.

I have negotiated with partners from many countries, and I have one simple rule. Never give something without getting something back. When a partner asks for a discount, I do not say yes, and I do not say no. I say: yes, if. For example: yes, if you sign for two years, we will give you a discount. Or: yes, if you pay upfront, we can lower the price. The condition is important, because it shows that the price has a reason. And the other side usually accepts it, because they also get something. That is how you meet halfway, and that is how you get a real win-win.

I work with Brazilian partners every month, and I have learned a few things. First, they prefer to build a relationship before they talk about the price. So I never start with numbers. When I receive a counteroffer, I do not answer in the same call. I say: thank you, I will think about it and send you an answer tomorrow. That day is important. It shows respect, and it gives me time to talk to my team. And at the end of every negotiation, I always ask the same question: so, what do we both need to make this work? If both sides answer honestly, we usually agree on the terms very fast.

Thinking about becoming a member of the chamber? Here is our special offer for new member companies. If you join before December, you will get a twenty percent discount in your first year. If you pay the full year upfront, we will also give you two free tickets to our business breakfast. And if you sign for two years, your company will get a free booth at our next trade fair. To learn more, reach out to our partnership team. We will be happy to find the best package for your company.
